name: mapping-binding-pattern-test-514c7df011/mapping-binding-pattern-v.bal
spec_references: Statements — Match statement: Currently only supports const-pattern and wildcard-match-pattern
reason: The asserted matching behavior requires mapping binding/match patterns that extract fields, accept additional fields, reject missing fields, recursively match nested mappings, and bind values for guarded returns. These patterns are outside the explicitly supported constant and wildcard match patterns.
unsupported_constructs: Mapping binding patterns in match clauses, including var {a: x}, shorthand var {i, s}, empty var {}, and {x: var a, y: var b}
Nested mapping patterns and alternatives of mapping binding patterns
Match guards applied to values captured by mapping binding patterns
test_design_notes: Assertions cover mapping, record (including defaulted fields), and JSON inputs, field extraction and narrowing, missing-field failures, extra-field acceptance, and nested patterns.
The io:println call is disabled instrumentation; assertion diagnostics use supported value:toString. Neither changes the classification.
